title: 任务完成
intent: 完成事实、保存记录和当前文件核实状态分开。
brief: A clean completed task page, header file and local job. All required stage checks, title "这项处理已完成". Summary "处理客户设计", "已批准的 TIFF", "保存记录：1 份", "当前位置尚未再次检查". Small fox preview. Primary "开始新任务", secondary "查看保存记录" and "返回主页". No automatic printing, no fake file-present badge; no editing controls.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One high-fidelity raster screen for PrintFlow Studio SCRUM-11168 expanded visual prototype. Reference image is an APPROVED design-system and synthetic-artwork reference, not an edit target. Preserve its calm off-white and white surfaces, forest teal #16765D, graphite text, thin dividers, sensible 10px corners, generous efficient spacing, crisp Simplified Chinese CJK sans serif. Same original geometric mark, exact "PrintFlow Studio" titlebar, small "视觉原型 v2", window controls. One complete front-on edge-to-edge Windows desktop UI screenshot, landscape 16:10, no device/browser/outer presentation board. Same fox illustration and foliage as reference, identical sample artwork and transparent checkerboard when background removed. Default task filename 山野狐狸.png and route 处理客户设计, unless brief overrides. Default left eight-stage user rail: 导入与路线 / 确认原图 / 图片增强 / 去除背景 / 裁切画布 / 印刷设置 / 生成与审核 / 保存结果. Only stages before CURRENT are completed; future steps muted and nonexecutable. Footer fixed with one recommended primary and qualified secondary actions. Main picture and current decision are focal. No irrelevant future forms, no real customer data, no invented operational facts. Use exact quoted Chinese labels in brief; concise text only, no illegible filler. Check prompts' constraints carefully, don't add hidden behavior, automatic approval, auto-resume, printing, cloud or account features. All statuses and measurements are fictional scenario states for prototype, not evidence of a live production file. Output ONLY this one complete practical screen.
SCENARIO: 
IMPORTANT: Reference controls and text must NOT be copied when not in the scenario. Never show a fabricated enhanced result before processing starts. Use spinner only for unknown progress, never ratio-filled progress bars. Do not carry colleague-correction hints onto enhancement/other reviews. No default selection for white-ink choice. title: 准备同事修正
intent: 从去背景审核准备参考副本、工作副本和说明。
brief: Stage4 background review, title "请同事修正这张图片". Large current fox preview, optional multiline label "需要修正的地方" with text "请检查尾巴与花叶边缘。". Three file-type rows "原图参考副本", "修正工作副本", "操作说明". Note "准备后任务将移交；原图保持不变。". Primary "准备修正文件", secondary "取消，返回审核". No people directory, assignment accounts, messages, cloud or automatic file watching.

title: 等待修正与回导
intent: 明确已移交；由用户选择修正图片回导，再重新审核。
brief: Stage4 badge "已移交". Title "等待修正后的图片". A gentle three-step instruction "打开修正文件夹" / "请同事修正工作副本" / "导入返回的 PNG". A compact file-package area and small fox reference, no editable brush. Primary "导入修正后的图片"; secondary "打开修正文件夹"; collapsed "其他选项" containing "恢复自动处理". Text "不会自动监控或导入保存文件；导入后仍需审核。" No waiting percent or auto-approval.

title: 处理失败与重试
intent: 输入保留、原因明确，重试不自动开始。
brief: Stage3 enhancement failed. Title "增强步骤未完成". Calm amber status panel "美图未产生可确认的结果。"; preservation note "原图和上一步结果仍保留。"; next sentence "检查美图状态后，可重试此步骤。". Primary "重试此步骤" in teal, secondary "查看错误详情", tertiary "返回主页". Current fox original preview smaller. No stack trace, no false output, no automatically firing retry. Show code as secondary "错误代码：示例" rather than invented real code.
